title: Holoself per-machine self map (selves.json)
description: Per-user, per-machine map from a self_id to this machine's checkout of that self. Lives in HOLOSELF_CONFIG_DIR, %APPDATA%\holoself, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/holoself or ~/.config/holoself with mode 0600. Never synced or committed.

path.description: Absolute realpath of the self root on this machine.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the last registration.
